asr.full_text: President Trump apparently can't stop his love affair with Goldman Sachs So look at this. This is from The Intercept After using Goldman Sachs as a punching bag for his campaign sharply criticizing his political opponents for ties to the investment bank, Donald Trump has taken unprecedented steps to appoint former Goldman Sachs attorneys and executives to the upper echelons of government. Treasury Secretary Steve Mnuchin worked at Goldman Sachs for 17 years. Last month, Trump nominated Eric Uland, a former Goldman Sachs a lobbyist to serve as the under Secretary of State one of the most posts at the State Department So this is example number 17412 of how Donald Trump has absolutely positively no shame and in his mind Hypocrisy doesn't register. That's not a thing. So you can go back and you can look at the tape I mean we had Donald Trump go after Ted Cruz and go after Hillary Clinton relentlessly, mercilessly, over and over and over for their ties to Wall Street and specifically their ties to Goldman Sachs. And, he derided them as establishment shills and doing the bidding of their donors and all that stuff. He sounded, in many ways, with his rhetoric on the campaign trail like a progressive. The second he gets elected goes in the other direction. says, no, I'm going to now I'm going to become I'm gonna become an administration that has more Goldman Sachs officials more Wall Street bankers more executives in it than any other administration in history and Again, I mean any normal person would look at this and be a little surprised but Trump has demonstrated repeatedly that what he says is wholly irrelevant I mean, look at his rhetoric on uh jobs and outsourcing He says let's do a Made in America week We need to, you know buy America, America first This is how we must do things Meanwhile, if you look at him His products are made in 12 different countries. Twenty-one of the thirty-one items in his hotels are not made in America. So you have a guy who talks the talk in some respects but he refuses to walk the walk. Where is the open question. We can track exactly where you're products come from. And where they are made.
